prerequisites: Seeded Daniel Okafor (Administrator) and Nadia Haddad (Legal Team Member) with the seeded and shared-lab Tasks, Key dates and records.

Reviewer fixtures created by Daniel through the API: a DOC-029 access Home contract with one overdue Task for each seeded account and 55 Tasks for each fresh DOC-029 access account (53 dated, 2 undated), and a Confidential Contract outside Nadia's reach.
scenarios.expected: Links reach the intended records; Tasks remain distinct from deadline surfaces; ? opens shortcuts. Empty sections and unavailable records have useful outcomes; / and Escape retain their existing behavior.
scenarios.actual: 10 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3 as Daniel Okafor and a fresh Administrator. Home in the navigation showed Approvals waiting on you, Tasks assigned to you, Dates approaching, Entity obligations, Inbox, Your contracts and Your matters in that order, with no zero-total section. The reviewer Task title on Home opened its Contract's Tasks with the C- number and title; the Fields and Documents section links worked; Home returned. Your contracts rows all had Daniel as Owner, and Your matters rows all had him as Matter Manager. The Task's due date was absent from Dates approaching, whose View all opened Your dates. ? opened Keyboard shortcuts and Escape closed it. Escape closed the name menu. / focused Search, and ?/x typed there stayed in the field. Tab moved focus and Enter on a link navigated. Help in the header opened Help, and its search found Find your work on Home, not records. /contracts/999999 and /matters/999999 showed Contract not found and Matter not found with {reference} does not exist, or you cannot open it., and Back to Contracts and Back to Matters returned to the lists. The fresh Administrator's My Tasks said No open Tasks assigned to you. and Home had no Tasks card. With 55 Tasks, View all 55 opened Your Tasks with 50 rows, Load more Tasks added 5, and rows followed due date with undated Tasks last. Completing a Task showed Completed: {title} and Undo reopened it. Show completed changed the label to Hide completed and listed the completed Task; clearing its control showed Reopened: {title}. A Task title opened its Contract and Home in the navigation returned.
